task.description:
Step 0.5 — Issue Registry Lookup and GitHub Filing for ISS-0114 (GitHub issue #377).

The local registry entry docs/issues/ISS-0114.json already exists (registered 2026-08-01). Your tasks:

1. Read docs/issues/ISS-0114.json and confirm it accurately reflects the current symptom, root-cause hypothesis, and acceptance criteria from GitHub issue #377.

2. Search existing ISS-*.json files for prior related issues (use read_file on docs/issues/issue_index.json if it exists, plus grep for 'tenant schema', 'search_path', 'provisionTenantSchema', 'schemaNameForTenant' across docs/issues/ and docs/issue-reports/). The most directly related prior issue is ISS-0112 (RESOLVED via WF03-gh375-20260804) which addressed public.schema_migrations drift but did NOT touch the per-tenant schema isolation path. Verify that #377 is genuinely new work, not a duplicate of #359 / #375.

3. Check for GitHub issue #377 collision:
   gh issue list --search "ISS-0114" --state all
   gh issue list --search "tenant schema search_path" --state all
   If the local ISS-0114 ID collides with an unrelated GitHub issue, renumber the local entry (choose ISS-0114A or next free ISS-NNNN).

4. File (or re-confirm) the issue on GitHub if it has not been filed yet:
   gh issue create --title "ISS-0114 — Tenant schema and search_path state causes GH-359-class failures" --body "<mirror local ISS body + acceptance criteria>" --label "bug,integration"
   The body must include the <!-- rco-sync-ref: ISS-0114 --> marker at the top, mirroring the existing local file.

5. Update docs/issues/ISS-0114.json with:
   - handoff_id = <this handoff's id>
   - run_id = WF03-gh377-20260804
   - github_issue = https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/377 (already set; verify)
   - If GitHub issue was newly created, write the returned URL into the github_issue field.

6. Stage and commit any registry changes:
   git add docs/issues/ISS-0114.json handoffs/registry.json
   git commit -m "chore(WF03-gh377): register ISS-0114 in registry and confirm GitHub filing"

Return PASS when:
- Local ISS-0114.json is up to date
- GitHub issue #377 exists with the sync-ref marker
- Registry is committed on the feature branch

Set next_action to "Route to ISSUE-FIXER (Step 1 — Root Cause Diagnosis)".
